discovery_surface: Redacted local transparent capture of the completed headless session outbound /anthropic/v1/messages tools array.

candidate.name: Agent
description_facts: Launches a new agent for a caller-provided task.
Omitting subagent_type selects the general-purpose agent.
run_in_background=false provides a synchronous caller-readable result.

semantic_exclusions: Workflow accepts a workflow script for multi-agent orchestration and is not the single generic-worker task-packet port evaluated by this gate.
Skill selects a preconfigured skill package rather than accepting an unconstrained generic worker packet.
The remaining registered tools do not create a generic worker.
limitations: The transparent capture recorded request paths and the tools request body only; authorization headers and credential values were forwarded without logging.
This capture proves only the current session registration shape, not permission, capacity, isolation, execution, output validity, or host support.
The model response was used only to confirm session completion and was not used for primitive discovery or semantic selection.
No worker primitive was invoked during Gate 0.
